source.prompt: Pixel art sprite animation test footage, 32-bit era console style, crisp hard-edged pixels, limited palette, flat shading. The character stays EXACTLY the same design, proportions, colours and pixel scale as the first frame. Locked static camera, strict orthographic side view, no zoom, no pan, no camera motion. The background stays a perfectly flat solid pure bright green (#00FF00) with no shadow, no floor, no gradient, no particles, no impact flashes, no sparks, no motion lines, nothing else in frame. No text. The Gorgon Queen with serpent hair in an emerald gown performs ONE petrifying stare facing right: she leans forward slowly, her eyes opening wide, her serpents rearing up and fanning out around her head, holds the glare, then relaxes back, hovering in place. No magic effects, no energy, no beams, no glow, no light rays, no sparks: nothing leaves the hands or eyes, only the body gesture is animated.
